req.title: Pagination via skip and limit
req.statement: The system shall skip the first 'skip' items and cap the returned count at 'limit' when both are supplied to GET /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: The requirement mandates that GET /tasks/?skip=<s>&limit=<l> skips the first 'skip' items and caps results at 'limit'. The pre-loaded dataset has exactly 20 rows (ids 1-20). Tests cover: (1) EP positive — typical skip+limit returning a deterministic slice; (2) NEG negative — invalid skip/limit values (negative, zero-limit, out-of-range) triggering 422; (3) BVA boundary — skip=0/limit=1 (minimum limit), skip=19/limit=1 (last item), skip=20/limit=1 (empty result), limit=1000 (max allowed), limit=1001 (rejected); (4) DT decision-table — combinations of skip and limit to verify exact count arithmetic; (5) BVA on the skip offset to catch off-by-one mutations in the offset logic. All tests use in-process TestClient with a fresh SQLite DB seeded from the pre-loaded fixture rows, ensuring determinism and idempotency.

tests.name: test_pagination_typical_skip_and_limit
preconditions: Database contains exactly 20 pre-loaded tasks with ids 1-20
GET /tasks/ endpoint is available
actions: Capture response status and JSON body
expected: HTTP 200
Response body is a list of exactly 3 tasks
First task id is 6, second is 7, third is 8 (natural insertion order)
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import Base, get_db
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

tf = tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{tf}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
db = Session()
rows = [
    (1,'Read chapter 5','desc1',True),(2,'Book flight tickets','desc2',True),
    (3,'Submit expense report','desc3',True),(4,'Prepare meeting agenda','desc4',False),
    (5,'Write project report','desc5',False),(6,'Run unit tests',None,False),
    (7,'Fix login bug','desc7',False),(8,'Prepare meeting agenda',None,False),
    (9,'Pay electricity bill','desc9',True),(10,'Organize desk',None,False),
    (11,'Water the plants','desc11',False),(12,'Review pull request',None,False),
    (13,'Buy groceries','desc13',False),(14,'Buy groceries',None,False),
    (15,'Renew gym membership',None,True),(16,'Fix login bug','desc16',False),
    (17,'Call the bank',None,False),(18,'Reply to emails',None,False),
    (19,'Schedule dentist appointment',None,True),(20,'Reply to emails','desc20',False)
]
for r in rows:
    db.add(models.Task(id=r[0],title=r[1],description=r[2],completed=r[3]))
db.commit()
db.close()
def override_get_db():
    s = Session()
    try: yield s
    finally: s.close()
app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)
resp = client.get('/tasks/?skip=5&limit=3')
assert resp.status_code == 200
body = resp.json()
assert len(body) == 3
assert body[0]['id'] == 6
assert body[1]['id'] == 7
assert body[2]['id'] == 8
os.unlink(tf)

from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app import models

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

tf = tempfile.mktemp(suffix='.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{tf}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
Session = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
db = Session()
rows = [
    (1,'Read chapter 5','desc1',True),(2,'Book flight tickets','desc2',True),
    (3,'Submit expense report','desc3',True),(4,'Prepare meeting agenda','desc4',False),
    (5,'Write project report','desc5',False),(6,'Run unit tests',None,False),
    (7,'Fix login bug','desc7',False),(8,'Prepare meeting agenda',None,False),
    (9,'Pay electricity bill','desc9',True),(10,'Organize desk',None,False),
    (11,'Water the plants','desc11',False),(12,'Review pull request',None,False),
    (13,'Buy groceries','desc13',False),(14,'Buy groceries',None,False),
    (15,'Renew gym membership',None,True),(16,'Fix login bug','desc16',False),
    (17,'Call the bank',None,False),(18,'Reply to emails',None,False),
    (19,'Schedule dentist appointment',None,True),(20,'Reply to emails','desc20',False)
]
for r in rows:
    db.add(models.Task(id=r[0],title=r[1],description=r[2],completed=r[3]))
db.commit()
db.close()

    s = Session()
    try: yield s
    finally: s.close()

assert resp.status_code == 200

assert len(body) == 1
task = body[0]
assert task['id'] == 1
assert task['title'] == 'Read chapter 5'
assert task['completed'] == True
assert 'created_at' in task
os.unlink(tf)
